source.sourceLessonTitleEnglish: Incident Report: Hand Injury at the Table Saw
source.sourceObjectiveEnglish: Say and write the timeline of a table-saw injury with times and facts only, without guessing the cause.
source.sourceSpeakingEnglish: You are the foreman, and the AI is safety manager Patricia León: walk her through the timeline of Samuel's table-saw injury in the past tense with time markers like a las 10:40, enseguida, unos minutos después and mientras esperábamos, giving facts only, no guesses.

openDomainReview.question: Preserve Héctor Salas, Patricia León, the Ortiz house jobsite, only witness Tomás Ruiz, Samuel's 10:40 saw work and the fact that Héctor did not see the cut. Decide Japanese time narration and witness/statement register without inferring injury cause.

Preserve the reported palm cut and bleeding, Rosa Díaz's first-aid training and gauze pressure, the source's 911 request, ambulance wait, unplugging and out-of-service tag, transport to hospital, photo sequence, blade guard and riving knife. Qualified trade/clinical/source review must resolve terminology and the source locale before Japanese selection; do not add treatment or regulatory claims.

Keep the push stick observed on the floor without claiming it was used, the explicit unknown cause, Patricia's requested photos and Rosa's statement, and the source's no-use-until-investigation line. Decide Japanese attribution and audience-specific register without changing evidentiary certainty.

rows.sourceSpanish: Soy Héctor Salas, capataz de la obra de la casa Ortiz, y ayer armé la cronología del accidente con Patricia León, la gerente de seguridad.
rows.sourceEnglish: I'm Héctor Salas, foreman of the Ortiz house build, and yesterday I put together the timeline of the accident with Patricia León, the safety manager.

rows.sourceSpanish: Patricia: Para el reporte de incidente necesito horas y hechos, no suposiciones.
rows.sourceEnglish: Patricia: For the incident report I need times and facts, not guesses.
rows.speaker: Patricia

rows.sourceSpanish: A las 10:40, Samuel cortaba una tabla en la sierra.
rows.sourceEnglish: At 10:40, Samuel was cutting a board on the saw.
rows.conditionalJapanesePhrase: 10時40分、サミュエルさんはテーブルソーで板を切っていました。

rows.sourceSpanish: Samuel gritó y Tomás Ruiz, el único testigo, apagó la sierra enseguida.
rows.sourceEnglish: Samuel shouted and Tomás Ruiz, the only witness, turned off the saw right away.

rows.sourceSpanish: Yo no vi el corte; llegué unos segundos después.
rows.sourceEnglish: I didn't see the cut; I got there a few seconds later.
rows.conditionalJapanesePhrase: けがをした瞬間は見ていません。私が着いたのは、その数秒後です。

rows.sourceSpanish: Rosa Díaz, la carpintera con entrenamiento en primeros auxilios, llegó corriendo al mismo tiempo que yo.
rows.sourceEnglish: Rosa Díaz, the carpenter with first-aid training, came running at the same time as me.

rows.sourceSpanish: Samuel tenía una cortada en la palma de la mano izquierda que sangraba mucho.
rows.sourceEnglish: Samuel had a cut on the palm of his left hand that was bleeding a lot.

rows.sourceSpanish: Enseguida, Rosa le aplicó presión directa con gasas del botiquín.
rows.sourceEnglish: Right away, Rosa applied direct pressure with gauze from the first-aid kit.
rows.conditionalJapanesePhrase: すぐに、ロサさんは救急箱のガーゼで傷口を直接押さえました。

rows.sourceSpanish: Rosa pidió que llamaran al 911, y mientras esperábamos la ambulancia, desconecté la sierra de mesa y le puse una etiqueta de fuera de servicio.
rows.sourceEnglish: Rosa asked someone to call 911, and while we were waiting for the ambulance, I unplugged the table saw and put an out-of-service tag on it.

rows.sourceSpanish: Unos minutos después, los paramédicos lo llevaron al hospital.
rows.sourceEnglish: A few minutes later, the paramedics took him to the hospital.
rows.conditionalJapanesePhrase: 数分後、救急隊員がサミュエルさんを病院へ搬送しました。

rows.sourceSpanish: Después tomé fotos sin tocar el disco ni mover nada de la mesa.
rows.sourceEnglish: Afterward I took photos without touching the blade or moving anything on the table.

rows.sourceSpanish: En las fotos se ve la guarda en su lugar y la cuchilla divisora detrás del disco.
rows.sourceEnglish: In the photos you can see the blade guard in place and the riving knife behind the blade.

rows.sourceSpanish: El empujador estaba en el piso junto a la sierra, pero no sé si Samuel lo usó.
rows.sourceEnglish: The push stick was on the floor next to the saw, but I don't know if Samuel used it.
Patricia: Do you know why it happened?
rows.speaker: Patricia

rows.sourceSpanish: Le contesté: No sé la causa; solo le digo lo que vi.
rows.sourceEnglish: I answered: I don't know the cause; I'm only telling you what I saw.
rows.speaker: I answered
rows.conditionalJapanesePhrase: 原因は分かりません。私が見たことだけをお伝えします。

rows.sourceSpanish: Al final le prometí: Patricia, le mando hoy las fotos y la declaración de Rosa.
rows.sourceEnglish: At the end I promised her: Patricia, I'll send you the photos and Rosa's statement today.
rows.speaker: At the end I promised her
rows.conditionalJapanesePhrase: パトリシアさん、今日中に写真とロサさんの目撃証言の記録をお送りします。

rows.sourceSpanish: Luego avisé a la cuadrilla: Nadie usa la sierra hasta que termine la investigación.
rows.sourceEnglish: Then I told the crew: Nobody uses the saw until the investigation is finished.
rows.speaker: Then I told the crew
rows.conditionalJapanesePhrase: 調査が終わるまで、このテーブルソーは使用禁止です。
